markets.rules_primary: If Augusto Cury finishes in 4th place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election according to the certified results, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Ranking is determined by the specified counting method:
For a two-round system where this event specifies the first round: rank is based on certified first-round vote count or percentage

If the election is cancelled or postponed beyond expiration, all markets resolve NO.
